evidence.reason: The dependency scan in unit-live-binding.py explicitly enumerates [Unit] dependency/stop-propagation directives and already includes the stop-propagating `PartOf` and `BindsTo` forms; its own comment says the scan must cover every loadable unit type and drop-in. The code also targets systemd v257 semantics (the `config_parse_also` docstring cites v257). Missing `StopPropagatedFrom=` and `PropagatesStopTo=` (v257's explicit stop-propagation pair) is therefore an incompleteness bug in the existing detection, not a new requirement: a co-installed unit with `StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service` would be silently stopped when the fence stops `crq-tick.service`, defeating the co-tenant protection the scan exists to provide. The smallest compatible fix is to add the two alternatives to the directive group; this is a routine, non-disruptive correctness repair requiring no owner decision.
